guest_address_model: one contiguous reserved range per DSO

permissions.RX: CodeMemory slave at guest address; owner retained at a private RW alias
permissions.R: CodeMemory slave at guest address; owner retained at a private RW alias
permissions.RW: CodeMemory owner mapped directly at guest address
permissions.None: guest range remains reserved but unmapped

relro: page-rounded ranges override base LOAD permissions to R before regions are merged
relocation: all 174187 slots are reapplied against final segmented guest bases; bytes are copied through each mapped RW owner after CreateCodeMemory and compared through the final guest mapping
safety: mapping failure unmaps every completed range, removes reservations, and leaves constructors gated
